subject: Re: Kickoff: DrJAX as our parallel-computation authoring layer
body:
Status + one risk before the readout.

Pilot one (Tereza, the federated-analytics style workload) migrated fully: authoring went from ~700 lines of hand-rolled pmap orchestration to ~120 lines of DrJAX map/reduce, and differentiating through the reduction — previously a custom-VJP minefield — is now just jax.grad. Performance within 3% of the tuned original on the same sharding.

Pilot two (Rosa's) surfaced the real risk: their computation mixes DrJAX reductions with manual collective ops, and the sharding annotations fight each other — we saw a 2.2x slowdown until we rewrote the offending block DrJAX-native. Lesson for the adoption guide: incremental mixed-mode migration is a trap; migrate whole computation blocks or don't.

The regression harness has caught two numerical diffs since going live June 2, both benign accumulation-order issues, both now documented. Readout drafting starts next week.

Yusuf
